title: Common providers: Brazil
coverage: Partial. Covers the national carriers, the mobile network operators, the largest fibre operators, two wholesale backbones, satellite and the research network; Brazil has thousands of regional ISPs that are not listed.
missing: Thousands of regional and municipal ISPs, which together serve a large share of fixed lines
Business ISPs and smaller wholesale carriers
Former names of Nio, Vero, Ligga and Giga+ Fibra (not confirmed on the read date)
An AS number for Nio (none was found registered to it)
Websites for Vivo, Giga+ Fibra and Alares (they did not answer an automated request on the read date)
The regulator's operator lists (its pages refused an automated request and its data panels were under maintenance on the read date)

sources.name: Anatel (Agência Nacional de Telecomunicações)
sources.terms: The inner pages refused an automated request on the read date: no reuse licence was read and nothing is copied.
sources.result: The front page answered on the read date; the licensing data panels showed a maintenance notice. It is the authority to consult for operators this pack lacks.

sources.name: Wikipedia: Internet in Brazil and 3 more pages
sources.terms: CC BY-SA 4.0. Used to cross-check names and former names only (facts); no text is copied.
sources.result: 11 of 20 entries were found by a name on the 4 pages read.

sources.name: Each provider's own public website
sources.terms: Only the address itself is recorded (a fact); no content is copied.
sources.result: 17 of 20 websites and 0 support or status pages answered an automated check; an address that did not answer is left empty.

sources.name: RIPEstat as-overview (RIPE NCC)
sources.terms: The RIPEstat terms forbid redistributing RIPEstat data: nothing is copied. Consulted to confirm, for each AS number, that the registered holder is the named provider or a company the entry names.
sources.result: 27 AS numbers confirmed; a number whose registered holder was an unrelated name was left out.

sources.name: RIPE NCC list of AS names
sources.terms: No licence statement was read: used only to find candidate AS numbers, each then confirmed as above; nothing is copied.
sources.result: Read to find which AS numbers are registered under each provider's company names.

sources.name: NRO delegated statistics (the regional registries' joint list of assigned AS numbers)
sources.terms: Published by the registries for public use; only which registry holds each AS number is taken (a fact).
sources.result: Every AS number in the pack was found in the list; its registry is recorded beside it.

sources.name: Wikidata
sources.terms: CC0 1.0: no conditions. The item id of a provider is recorded as a stable cross-reference.
sources.result: 1 entries carry the id of a Wikidata item that states one of the entry's AS numbers (property P3797).
